requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen, have graduated from high school and be over age 18.

requirements.ruleText: Meet Ministry of Education Document No. 12 [2020], including the applicable foreign-nationality, Chinese-nationality cancellation and overseas-residence evidence.

requirements.ruleText: Take CSCA and submit the score report for the official program-row subjects: Humanities Chinese, STEM Chinese, Mathematics.

references.locator: Program row CSCA test-subject columns and guide page 4 item 5

requirements.ruleText: Submit a passport valid for more than one year; applicants with prior China experience also submit all China-related visa and residence-permit pages.
Submit the senior-high-school diploma; graduating students may use a pre-graduation certificate.
Submit complete senior-high-school transcripts; SAT, IB, GCE A-Level or ACT evidence may also be supplied as published.
Submit the official CSCA transcript for the selected route.
HSK Level 4 or above, score 200 or above
Submit a certificate of no criminal record.
Submit a physical-examination record issued within six months before November 15, 2025.
Submit the Financial Support Guarantee Statement for International Students.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants to routes requiring extra records
requirements.ruleText: Submit route-specific additional materials; Architecture, Urban Planning and Landscape Architecture applicants must provide a portfolio.
Submit authentic Chinese or English records; records in other languages require notarized Chinese or English translations.
Complete the SEU online application, select only one funding route, upload all materials and pay the non-refundable RMB 800 application fee.

references.locator: Guide pages 3 and 5, fees and Application Process

requirements.ruleText: Pay the published annual tuition for this route: RMB 19,000/year.
Budget for RMB 800 insurance and the published RMB 9,000/year double-room occupancy charge where applicable.
Register at the time in the admission notice with the admission and visa records, prepaid-fee receipt where applicable, and original diploma, transcript and language certificates.

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen under age 45.
Hold a bachelor's degree or higher.
Have at least three years of related work experience.
Be a senior public official, manager or university/research scholar from a Belt and Road country within the published target profile.
Demonstrate the ability to undertake professional courses in English.
Apply to SEU by March 15, 2026, obtain pre-admission after review, then complete the CSC Type A application using agency 1563 by March 31, 2026.
Submit a valid passport copy.
Submit the required physical-examination report.
Submit a certificate of no criminal record.
Submit the highest degree diploma and complete academic transcripts.
Submit two recommendation letters and an employment or in-service certificate.
Submit the published study or research plan and English-proficiency evidence.
Follow the two-year 1+1 model: year one at SEU, year two thesis work in the home country, followed by return for defense.
This is a full Chinese Government Scholarship route; the official SEU guide does not itemize components or publish a self-financed tuition alternative.
